reference_resolution.rule: doc_id must resolve to an actual documentation file — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: quadrant is exclusive per Diataxis — a doc belongs to exactly one quadrant, recomputed by re-classifying content against the quadrant's own structural markers, never asserted standalone.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: new user-facing documentation is proposed on the branch AND no technical-writing record exists yet for that doc_id
